card.name: Subsection numbers in section cross-references
card.fires_on: The digit after the decimal point in a section cross-reference such as (2.1, 2.3) in a drug label, mostly the second or later number in the list. Also fires on the word Financing in a cash flow heading.

modes.label: Cross-reference digit
modes.description: A subsection digit after a dot inside parentheses citing label sections, after earlier numbers in the list.

modes.label: Financing in cash flow
modes.description: The word Financing in a cash flow heading.
